Each `set(value)` updates `self.value` to the new value and recomputes `self.smooth` as `(1 - _smoothing) * value + _smoothing * old_smooth` unless `smooth` is `None`; `reset()` restores both `value` and `smooth` to `_initial` without changing `_initial` or `_smoothing`.

Starting from `SmoothValue(2.0, 0.6)`: after the first three sets, `smooth` becomes `5.2`, then `11.12`, then `8.672`. `reset()` puts both `value` and `smooth` back to `2.0`. The final three sets then give `smooth = 0.4*100 + 0.6*2 = 41.2`, then `0.4*50 + 0.6*41.2 = 44.72`, then `0.4*25 + 0.6*44.72 = 36.831999999999994`. So at return, `value = 25.0`, `smooth = 36.831999999999994`, `_initial = 2.0`, `_smoothing = 0.6`, which round to the requested values.
